p: he looked up: According to the judgment of God, the poor may even exceed the rich in generosity and liberality.
And as some spake of the: The destruction of the temple is foretold so that the true spiritual building may be built, whose chief builders must and ought to be cautious.
gifts: These were things that were hung up on walls and pillars.
in my name: Using my name.

But when ye shall hear of: The true temple of God is built up even in the midst of incredible tumults and most severe miseries, and this through invincible patience, so that the end result can be nothing else but most happy.

a testimony: This will be the result of your troubles and afflictions: they will be witnesses both before God and man of the treacherous and cruel dealing of your enemies, as well as of your steadfastness: A noble saying, that the afflictions of the godly and holy men pertain to the witness of the truth.
possess ye your souls: Though you are surrounded on all sides with many miseries, yet nonetheless be valiant and courageous, and bear out these things bravely.
And when ye shall see Jerusalem: The final destruction of the whole city is foretold.
wrath upon this people: By "wrath" are meant those things which God sends when he is displeased.
edge of the sword: Literally, "mouth", for the Hebrews call the edge of a sword the mouth because the edge of the sword bites.

And there shall be signs in: When the times have expired which are appointed for the salvation of the Gentiles and the punishment of the Jews: And so he changes topics from the destruction of Jerusalem to the history of the latter judgment.
Men's hearts failing them for fear: After various severe trials the Lord will at last plainly appear to deliver his Church.
And he spake to them a: We must be sober and watchful both day and night for the Lord's coming, so that we are not taken unexpectedly.
on all them that dwell on: On all men wherever they may be.
stand before the Son of man: You will appear before him in a condition such that you will abide the presence and sentence of the Judge without fear.
